corrective_actions: Committed narrower view filter at6ee4e74 before regenerated v2 method displays.
For later table inspection, display column names only; never data rows.
Method-only decisions remain separate from future outcome extraction.

known_incidents.description: Masked method windows or broad paragraph searches included qualitative result descriptions, spelled numerical/count expressions, or nearby evaluation prose. No outcome values were transcribed into eligibility decisions.

An ad-hoc dataset-location command inadvertently printed unmasked general safety-classification table rows. The task decision was made from the benchmark identities and evaluation task, not those values. The exposure is disclosed; values are not copied into the research artifacts.

limitations: The initial views and some method-search displays were imperfect exposure barriers. This is a disclosure, not a claim of perfect blinding or full-paper independent review.
masking: Numeric strings masked in method views; tables omitted by the committed HTML view helper. Early broad views and ad-hoc inspection sometimes included masked qualitative result statements. These were not used for decisions.
